all_quotes.quote: In this paper we utilise data from the ALMA-PILS survey targeting the protostellar binary IRAS 16293–2422 (IRAS16923 hereafter) using the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array.

The aim of this paper is to systematically survey the deuteration and the $^{13}$C content of a variety of oxygen-bearing complex organic molecules on Solar System scales toward the “B component” of the protostellar binary IRAS 16293–2422.
